keyEvents.text: Substitution, Atalanta. Nikola Krstovic replaces Gianluca Scamacca.
Goal! Roma 0, Atalanta 1. Éderson (Atalanta) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Roma. Nahuel Molina replaces Emanuele Lulli.
Substitution, Roma. Matías Soulé replaces Rodrigo Mora.
Substitution, Roma. Daniele Ghilardi replaces Gianluca Mancini.
Substitution, Roma. Santiago Castro replaces Donyell Malen.
Substitution, Atalanta. Nicola Zalewski replaces Eljif Elmas.
Substitution, Atalanta. Mario Pasalic replaces Lazar Samardzic.
Substitution, Roma. Leonardo Balerdi replaces Evan Ndicka.
Substitution, Atalanta. Davide Zappacosta replaces Sead Kolasinac.
Substitution, Atalanta. Franck Kessie replaces Éderson.
Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Roma 1, Atalanta 1. Mario Hermoso (Roma) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Matías Soulé with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Roma 2, Atalanta 1. Matías Soulé (Roma) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Paulo Dybala.
Gianluca Gaetano (Atalanta) is shown the red card.
